title: Hypocrellin A against intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma via multi-target inhibition of the PI3K-AKT-mTOR, MAPK, and STAT3 signaling pathways.
authors: Chen, Bo; Chen, Qiwen; Lu, Mengmeng; Zou, Enguang; Lin, Ganglian; Yao, Jiangqiao; Wang, Lushuang; Gan, Yuqian; Chen, Bicheng; Chen, Gang; Wu, Lijun
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Hypocrellin A对肝内胆管癌的多靶点抑制机制，涉及信号通路和分子对接，但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，且方法以实验为主，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (ICC) is an aggressive and highly lethal cancer with an increasing incidence worldwide that lacks effective treatment regimens. Hypocrellin A (HA), a natural small compound isolated from S. bambusicola, has multiple biomedical activities, including antitumor activity. PURPOSE: We intended to investigate the therapeutic effects of HA on ICC and its potential mechanisms. METHODS: RBE and HuccT1 cell lines were utilized for in vitro experiments. CCK8 assay, colony formation analysis, RTCA, and immunofluorescence staining of ki67 were employed to evaluate the suppression effects of HA on proliferation. The inhibitory effects of HA on cell migration and invasion were evaluate through transwell and wound healing assays, and Hoechst 33,258 staining was performed to evaluate apoptosis. Additionally, we performed transcriptome sequencing and molecular docking for targeting identification, and immunoblotting and immunofluorescence of key molecules for validation. Two in vivo models, HuccT1 xenografts, and the primary ICC model (KRAS/P19/SB) established via hydrodynamic tail-vein injection were implemented. Multiplex immunohistochemistry (mIHC) was used to illustrate the multi-target inhibitory effects of HA. RESULTS: The IC50 values of HA against RBE and HuccT1 cells were 4.612 muM and 10.01 muM for 24 h, as determined through the CCK8 assay. Our results confirmed that HA significantly repressed the proliferation, migration, invasion, and promoted the apoptosis of ICC cells at low concentrations. Moreover, HA exerted its anti-cancer effects through multi-target inhibition of the PI3K-AKT-mTOR, MAPK, and STAT3 signaling pathways. This inhibitory effect was rescued by Recilisib, an activator of the PI3K-AKT-mTOR pathway. Bioinformatics analysis of a multi-center RNA-Seq cohort (n = 90) demonstrated significant associations between these target pathways and the occurrence and poor prognosis of ICC. Animal studies suggested that HA strongly inhibited tumor growth in xenograft ICC models, and repressed the tumor number and size in the liver of primary ICC models by suppressing these three crucial pathways. CONCLUSION: HA, a novel natural small molecule, demonstrated promising therapeutic efficacy against ICC through its multi-target inhibitory effects on the PI3K-AKT-mTOR, MAPK, and STAT3 signaling pathways. Moreover, it exhibited notable therapeutic benefits in a primary ICC model (KRAS/P19/SB), positioning it as a novel therapeutic agent for ICC.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝内胆管癌（ICC）是一种侵袭性强且高度致命的癌症，全球发病率不断上升，目前缺乏有效的治疗方案。竹黄菌（S. bambusicola）中分离出的天然小分子化合物竹红菌素A（HA）具有多种生物医学活性，包括抗肿瘤活性。目的：我们旨在研究HA对ICC的治疗效果及其潜在机制。方法：采用RBE和HuccT1细胞系进行体外实验。通过CCK8实验、集落形成分析、RTCA和ki67免疫荧光染色评估HA对增殖的抑制作用。通过transwell和伤口愈合实验评估HA对细胞迁移和侵袭的抑制作用，并通过Hoechst 33,258染色评估细胞凋亡。此外，我们进行了转录组测序和分子对接以进行靶点鉴定，并通过免疫印迹和关键分子的免疫荧光进行验证。建立了两种体内模型，即HuccT1异种移植瘤和通过流体力学尾静脉注射建立的原发性ICC模型（KRAS/P19/SB）。使用多重免疫组化（mIHC）阐明HA的多靶点抑制作用。结果：通过CCK8实验测定，HA对RBE和HuccT1细胞的IC50值在24小时分别为4.612 μM和10.01 μM。我们的结果证实，HA在低浓度下显著抑制ICC细胞的增殖、迁移、侵袭，并促进其凋亡。此外，HA通过多靶点抑制PI3K-AKT-mTOR、MAPK和STAT3信号通路发挥其抗癌作用。这种抑制作用可被PI3K-AKT-mTOR通路激活剂Recilisib逆转。多中心RNA-Seq队列（n = 90）的生物信息学分析表明，这些靶点通路与ICC的发生和不良预后显著相关。动物研究表明，HA在异种移植ICC模型中强烈抑制肿瘤生长，并通过抑制这三条关键通路，减少原发性ICC模型肝脏中的肿瘤数量和大小。结论：HA作为一种新型天然小分子，通过其对PI3K-AKT-mTOR、MAPK和STAT3信号通路的多靶点抑制作用，展现出对ICC的有前景的治疗效果。此外，它在原发性ICC模型（KRAS/P19/SB）中表现出显著的治疗益处，使其成为ICC的新型治疗药物。
